messages:
sara (SRE): Quick follow-up from the regional failover postmortem — putting all DR action items here so owners can ack and we can track timelines.

sara (SRE): TL;DR: repeated routing flaps + partial restore got us into a degraded multi-region state. Need clear owners for routing policies, backups, and a tested restore runbook.

mike (Infra): thanks. I skimmed the postmortem, I can take ownership of multi-region routing policy updates and the canary routing test plan. ETA: 2 weeks for config changes, 1 week for test harness.

jason (Eng): I can own the KV backup verification and automation. Proposal: add end-to-end restore test to weekly game day pipeline. Need a small quota of infra to run restores.

anya (Product): I'll prioritize the customer-facing notes and escalation playbook updates. Also want to decide RTO/RPO targets for Dedicated customers — can we confirm these?

sara (SRE): RTO/RPO: we proposed tiered targets in the postmortem doc (prod-critical: RTO 15m / RPO 5m; standard: RTO 1h / RPO 15m). @anya can you confirm acceptance with commercial?

anya (Product): I'll sync with AE and compliance today, report back by EOD Friday.

mike (Infra): Routing action items (owner: mike):
- Update smart-routing to prefer region-primary for pinned customers (config PR)
- Add fallback route priorities for burst events
- Add circuit-breaker threshold to avoid cascading re-routes
Timeline: config PR by 1764612690 (2w). Canary tests: 1764716290 (3w).

jason (Eng): Backups action items (owner: jason):
- Verify cross-region snapshot retention and consistency checks
- Add automated restore verification script (success criteria: data integrity + service smoke tests)
- Integrate restore verification into weekly game day pipeline
Timeline: verification script by 1764341490 (1w), pipeline integration by 1764946290 (3w).

oncall-bot: reminder: create ticket for restore-runbook dry run.

sara (SRE): Runbook & game day (owner: sara):
- Finalize DR runbook steps (play-by-play, command snippets, responsible roles)
- Schedule an internal game day focused on partial restores + routing failovers
- Add post-game-day checklist and publish to runbooks repo
Timeline: runbook draft by 1764100090 (3d), game day scheduled week of 1764488890 (10d).

mike (Infra): For canary routing tests, I want to include a failure injection matrix: link to proposed tests in #eng-infra later. Also will add traffic shaping so we don't blow prod.

jason (Eng): One recurring pattern I noticed: config drift across regions caused mismatch in route rules. Action: snapshot and diff routing configs daily and alert on divergence (owner: infra config team). Suggest small pager rule to catch unexpectedly large diffs.

anya (Product): For customers with Dedicated, can we offer a DR runbook review as an add-on? Will coordinate with sales if we can include an audit.

sara (SRE): Can each owner drop a short ticket with acceptance criteria into the incident board by EOD tomorrow? We need traceability for the postmortem follow-ups.

mike (Infra): will create tickets for routing PR + canary; linking to this thread.

jason (Eng): tickets for backup verification + pipeline integration created: INC-DR-4523, INC-DR-4524.

anya (Product): I'll create escalation & customer comms ticket.

sara (SRE): Good. Plan to run an internal game day in ~2 weeks — exact date to be confirmed after infra quota is allocated. Please ack ownership here when you have it.

mike (Infra): acked.

jason (Eng): acked.

anya (Product): acked.

sara (SRE): closing loop: I'll compile a short weekly status update on these items and post to #incidents every Friday until all items are closed. If anyone needs to reassign, ping me. :thumbsup:
